abstract: PuzzleBoard introduces a camera calibration target that combines the subpixel corner-detection accuracy of a checkerboard / chessboard with a low-resolution position-encoded code embedded in each cell. The pattern enables robust corner detection, decoding, and partial-view calibration where the full board is not visible, while remaining backwards-compatible with classical checkerboard pipelines. Useful for camera intrinsic / extrinsic calibration, hand-eye calibration, and fiducial / calibration target detection in industrial vision setups.
reason: Calibration target with subpixel-accurate corner detection plus a position code per cell — handles partial-view and partially-occluded boards while staying compatible with checkerboard pipelines. In Use as a practical alternative to plain checkerboards / ChArUco for camera calibration.
title: PuzzleBoard: A New Camera Calibration Pattern with Position Encoding
